nodes.description: Address of the fixed implementation contract stored in storage slot 0; set once in the constructor and read by the fallback via sload(0).
Constructor that initialises the immutable implementation address from the deployment argument.
Payable fallback that forwards calldata to the implementation using delegatecall inside inline assembly, so the implementation code runs in this contract's storage context.
Payable receive function that emits the Received event with the value, sender and calldata.
Externally controlled caller address used in the receive event emission.
Low-level delegatecall executed in the fallback against the stored implementation; arbitrary code executes with the proxy's storage and balance.
Constructor argument supplying the implementation address, written into the implementation state variable.
Assembly local holding sload(0), i.e. the implementation address, used as the delegatecall destination.

edges.reason: The constructor parameter _implementation is assigned to the implementation state variable.
The constructor writes the implementation storage slot, which determines the delegatecall target for all later calls.
The fallback function unconditionally executes the delegatecall assembly block.
The delegatecall destination is read from the implementation storage slot, so control of that slot controls the executed code.
The fallback loads storage slot 0 into the local variable target before delegating.
The local target value is the address passed as the target of the delegatecall.
The untrusted msg.sender is emitted in the Received event by the receive function.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter only exists to be stored into the implementation state variable during construction, so it can be merged into the constructor node.
The assembly local target is only used as the destination operand of the delegatecall, so it can be merged into the unsafe_operation node.
